title: Madeira Sponge
description: A British classic — slightly heavier than Victoria sponge but with the same lovely flavour. Made with eggs, caster sugar and cornflour for a light, golden-crusted sponge.

ingredients.text: 140g caster sugar, plus extra for dusting

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease and line a 20cm round cake tin.
Whisk the eggs with an electric whisk for 3–4 minutes until doubled in size and creamy yellow.
Add the sugar and whisk again until combined. Sift in the cornflour and stir roughly, then whisk the whole mixture for another couple of minutes until thick and smooth.
Pour into the cake tin and tap on a table to remove air bubbles. Bake for 25 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin over a wire rack. Once cool, ease the cake out and dust with caster sugar.
notes: Serves 8. Top with fresh fruit, poached pears or maraschino cherries, or sandwich with jam and cream.
